source.source_version: USDA FNS CSFP Factsheet page retrieved 2026-10-29; publisher page update 2026-02-17

mappings.statement: Participants must be at least 60 years of age.
State agencies and Indian Tribal Organizations set household income limits at or below 150% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines; an agency may set a lower limit.
mappings.unresolved_reason: The federal ceiling is not the applicant's state/ITO limit; the state-specific limit and income calculation have not been sourced and mapped. Separate USDA page text reports a conflicting 130% threshold and requires reconciliation before income comparison.

mappings.statement: A state agency or Indian Tribal Organization may set designated service-area residency requirements and may require nutritional risk as determined by a physician or local agency staff.
mappings.unresolved_reason: These are optional state/ITO conditions. The applicable local agency rules and source-backed profile predicates are not mapped.

mappings.statement: CSFP may not be available in every area within a participating state; applicants must verify local availability with the state distributing agency or local agency.
mappings.unresolved_reason: This is a local availability check, not a profile criterion.

evaluation_boundary: Evaluate only the published minimum-age clause. This is not a CSFP eligibility result. Preserve unknown age bands and all unmapped state/ITO rules as unresolved; do not apply federal income ceilings as state limits.
